cardEffects:
[On Play] You may place 1 [SkullKnightmon] and 1 [DeadlyAxemon] from your hand and/or trash in this Digimon's digivolution cards in any order.
[All Turns] When this Digimon would be deleted, you may play 1 [SkullKnightmon] and 1 [DeadlyAxemon] from this Digimon's digivolution cards suspended without paying their memory costs.
name: DarkKnightmon

references.text: Official JP Q&A for BT7-063 (translated by DeepL)
Official JP Q&A for BT7-063 (2022/07/15, translated by DeepL)

rulings.answer: Yes. You don't have to place both a [SkullKnightmon] and a [DeadlyAxemon]. You can also place either of them on their own from either your hand or trash in this Digimon's digivolution cards.
rulings.question: Can this card's [On Play] effect place cards in this Digimon's digivolution cards if I don’t have both a [SkullKnightmon] and [DeadlyAxemon] in either my hand or trash?

rulings.answer: Yes. You can mix and match [SkullKnightmon] and [DeadlyAxemon] from both your hand and trash to place in this Digimon’s digivolution cards.
rulings.question: Can this card's [On Play] effect place a [SkullKnightmon] in my hand and a [DeadlyAxemon] in my trash in this Digimon’s digivolution cards?

rulings.answer: No. The effect reads, “you may,” so you can choose whether to play them. However, if both [SkullKnightmon] and [DeadlyAxemon] are in digivolution cards, you must choose to either play both of them or play none of them.
rulings.question: If I have both [SkullKnightmon] and [DeadlyAxemon] in this Digimon’s digivolution cards, does this card’s [All Turns] effect require me to play both?

rulings.answer: The [All Turns] effect triggers and activates immediately prior to the Digimon being deleted. In this way, the [All Turns] effect has the same timing as effects that say, “when this Digimon would be deleted”.
rulings.question: When does the [All Turns] effect of the Digimon trigger?

rulings.answer: No. Even if you only had either "Skull Knightmon" or "Deadly Axmon", you can still place them on the digivolution card.
rulings.question: Can this card's [On Play] effect be placed in the digivolving card unless I have both "Skull Knightmon" and "Deadly Axmon" in my hand or trash?

rulings.answer: Yes, you can put "Skull Knightmon" and "Deadly Axmon" from both hand and trash to digivolution card.
rulings.question: Can this card's [On Play] effect put "Skull Knightmon" from my hand and "Deadly Axmon" from my trash to digivolving card respectively?

rulings.answer: No, it is "can appear" and you can choose whether or not to have it play. However, if you have both "Skull Knightmon" and "Deadly Axmon" as digivolution cards, you can either play both of them or none of them.
rulings.question: For this card's [All Turns] effect, if there are both "Skull Knightmon" and "Deadly Axmon" as digivolves, do I always have to play both?
